verdict.rationale: Gemini's Notebooks feature explicitly provides 'a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions' and lets users 'organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space,' directly matching the story of grouping chats/files with shared context. Custom Gems further let users pre-load instructions/goals into a persistent context, and community evidence corroborates NotebookLM-style project use for large source corpuses. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of Notebooks (not just NotebookLM), details on team/multi-user sharing of a project space, and clarity on how instructions persist across linked chats within the same space.
